sql:
select  
  races_1.circuitid, 
  circuits_1.location
from 
  races as races_1

    on (races_1.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
where races_1.round is not NULL;

sql:
(select  
    circuits_1.lat, 
    circuits_1.lng, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    circuits_1.name, 
    circuits_1.circuitid, 
    circuits_1.country

    circuits as circuits_1
  where circuits_1.lat is not NULL

(select  
    circuits_1.lat, 
    circuits_1.lng, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    circuits_1.name, 
    circuits_1.circuitid, 
    circuits_1.country

    circuits as circuits_1

sql:
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorid
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
  where constructors_1.constructorid is not NULL

(select  
    constructors_1.constructorid
  from

nl: Combine the results of finding all constructor identifiers and finding all constructor identifiers.

sql:
(select  
    races_1.time
  from 
    races as races_1
  where races_1.round is not NULL

(select

  from

  );
nl: Combine the results of finding the start times of all races with a specified round and the start times of all races with a known race identifier.

sql:
(select  
    constructor_results_1.constructorid, 
    qualifying_1.date, 
    constructor_results_2.points, 
    constructor_results_1.points, 
    results_1.date, 
    results_1.grid, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorid
  from 
    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
          inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
            inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
            on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = qualifying_1.qualifyid )
          on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = qualifying_1.qualifyid )
        inner join results as results_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = results_1.resultid )
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
      on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid )
  where constructor_results_1.date is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    constructor_results_1.constructorid, 
    qualifying_1.date, 
    constructor_results_2.points, 
    constructor_results_1.points, 
    results_1.date, 
    results_1.grid, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorid
  from 
    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
          inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
            inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
            on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = qualifying_1.qualifyid )
          on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = qualifying_1.qualifyid )
        inner join results as results_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = results_1.resultid )
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
      on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid )
  where qualifying_1.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of points earned by constructors in races where the date of the constructor result is known and the performance details of their drivers, with the points earned by constructors in races where the qualifying session's race identifier is known and the performance details of their drivers.

sql:
(select

(select

sql:

(select

sql:
(select

(select

(select

sql:

sql:

sql:

  constructor_results_1.points, 
  max(
    constructor_results_1.points)
from 
  constructor_results as constructor_results_1
where constructor_results_1.constructorid <= constructor_results_1.raceid
group by constructor_results_1.points;

sql:
(select

    constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid, 
    constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorid, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    constructor_results_1.date, 
    constructor_results_1.points

    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )
      on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )
  where constructor_results_1.points is not NULL

(select  
    drivers_1.driverref, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid, 
    constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorid, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    constructor_results_1.date, 
    constructor_results_1.points

    constructor_results as constructor_results_1

        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )
      on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )
  where constructor_results_1.points is not NULL
  );

(select

    constructor_results_1.constructorid,

(select

    constructor_results_1.constructorid,

sql:

  constructor_results_1.date, 
  qualifying_1.position, 
  qualifying_1.number, 
  qualifying_1.qualifyid, 
  avg(
    constructor_results_1.constructorid)
from 
  constructor_results as constructor_results_1

(select

(select

sql:
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorid, 
    constructors_1.nationality, 
    qualifying_1.number, 
    drivers_1.nationality
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
      inner join constructors as constructors_1
          inner join drivers as drivers_1
          on (constructors_1.constructorid = drivers_1.driverid )
        inner join results as results_1
        on (results_1.driverid = drivers_1.driverid )
      on (qualifying_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
  where results_1.position >= results_1.milliseconds
  )
UNION
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorid, 
    constructors_1.nationality, 
    qualifying_1.number, 
    drivers_1.nationality
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
      inner join constructors as constructors_1
          inner join drivers as drivers_1
          on (constructors_1.constructorid = drivers_1.driverid )
        inner join results as results_1
        on (results_1.driverid = drivers_1.driverid )
      on (qualifying_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
  where constructors_1.constructorref is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of constructor and driver nationalities, along with car numbers, for races where a driver's final position was greater than or equal to their total milliseconds, and finding all instances of constructor and driver nationalities, along with car numbers, for constructors that have a reference.

(select

sql:

sql:

    drivers_1.dob, 
    constructors_1.constructorid, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    constructors_1.constructorref
  from

    circuits_1.lat, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    circuits_1.location, 
    circuits_1.name, 
    circuits_1.country

  )

(select  
    circuits_1.alt, 
    circuits_1.lat, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    circuits_1.location, 
    circuits_1.name, 
    circuits_1.country
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
  where circuits_1.lat > circuits_1.lng
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all race tracks with a known altitude and those where the latitude is greater than the longitude, including their altitude, latitude, reference, location, name, and country.

sql:
(select  
    drivers_1.dob, 
    drivers_1.driverid, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    drivers_1.code, 
    drivers_1.driverref
  from 
    drivers as drivers_1
  where drivers_1.surname is not NULL
  )

(select  
    drivers_1.dob, 
    drivers_1.driverid, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    drivers_1.code, 
    drivers_1.driverref
  from 
    drivers as drivers_1
  where drivers_1.nationality is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all driver information, excluding those whose nationality is known.

sql:
(select  
    qualifying_1.number
  from 
    standings as standings_1
      inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
      on (standings_1.driverstandingsid = qualifying_1.qualifyid )
  where standings_1.driverid is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    qualifying_1.number
  from 
    standings as standings_1
      inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
      on (standings_1.driverstandingsid = qualifying_1.qualifyid )
  where qualifying_1.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of car numbers driven by drivers with standings and those that participated in races, considering all instances where either a driver has standings or a race identifier exists.

sql:
select  
  constructor_results_1.constructorid, 
  constructor_results_2.constructorid
from 
  constructor_results as constructor_results_1
    inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
    on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid )
where constructor_results_1.raceid is not NULL;
nl: Find all instances of constructor results where the same constructor ID appears in both sets of results for races with a valid race ID.

sql:
(select  
    drivers_1.surname, 
    races_1.date, 
    races_1.circuitid, 
    races_1.raceid, 
    drivers_1.driverid, 
    drivers_1.driverref, 
    drivers_2.driverref
  from 
    races as races_1
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (races_1.raceid = drivers_1.driverid )
      inner join drivers as drivers_2
      on (races_1.raceid = drivers_2.driverid )
  where drivers_2.nationality is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    drivers_1.surname, 
    races_1.date, 
    races_1.circuitid, 
    races_1.raceid, 
    drivers_1.driverid, 
    drivers_1.driverref, 
    drivers_2.driverref
  from 
    races as races_1
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (races_1.raceid = drivers_1.driverid )
      inner join drivers as drivers_2
      on (races_1.raceid = drivers_2.driverid )
  where drivers_2.nationality is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all instances of driver surname, race date, circuit id, race id, driver id, and driver reference for races where a second driver's nationality is not null, excluding those that are also instances of the same information for races with a second driver having a non-null nationality.

sql:
(select  
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
  where constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
  where constructor_standings_1.date = constructor_standings_1.date
  );
nl: Find all instances of constructor standings IDs, excluding those where the date is equal to itself.

sql:
select  
  results_1.resultid, 
  results_1.number, 
  results_1.rank, 
  results_1.raceid, 
  results_1.driverid, 
  results_1.position, 
  results_1.points, 
  results_1.constructorid, 
  results_1.grid, 
  min(
    results_1.date)
from 
  results as results_1
where results_1.constructorid is not NULL
group by results_1.constructorid, results_1.driverid, results_1.grid, results_1.number, results_1.points, results_1.position, results_1.raceid, results_1.rank, results_1.resultid;
nl: Find the earliest date for each combination of driver performance metrics, including their rank, race, driver, position, points, constructor, grid, and result, but only consider performances where a constructor is specified.

sql:
(select  
    races_1.year, 
    races_1.raceid, 
    races_1.date
  from 
    races as races_1
  where races_1.date is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    races_1.year, 
    races_1.raceid, 
    races_1.date
  from 
    races as races_1
  where races_1.time is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all Grand Prix events with a recorded date and those with a specified time.

sql:
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorid, 
    constructors_1.name
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
  where constructors_1.name > constructors_1.constructorref
  )
UNION
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorid, 
    constructors_1.name
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
  where constructors_1.name is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all constructors whose name comes after their reference and all constructors that have a name.

sql:
(select distinct 
    circuits_1.lat, 
    circuits_1.location
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
  where circuits_1.lat is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    circuits_1.lat, 
    circuits_1.location
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
  where circuits_1.country > circuits_1.location
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all locations and latitudes of race tracks with known latitude values and those where the country name comes after the location name.

sql:
(select  
    qualifying_1.driverid, 
    constructor_results_1.constructorid
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      on (qualifying_1.qualifyid = constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid )
  where qualifying_1.driverid is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    qualifying_1.driverid, 
    constructor_results_1.constructorid
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      on (qualifying_1.qualifyid = constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid )
  where qualifying_1.number is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of drivers who participated in qualifying sessions with their corresponding team results and those who had a car number assigned during qualifying, including instances where either the driver or the car number is known.

sql:
(select  
    qualifying_1.number, 
    qualifying_1.driverid, 
    qualifying_1.qualifyid, 
    qualifying_1.date, 
    qualifying_1.constructorid
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
  where qualifying_1.date = qualifying_1.date
  )
UNION
(select  
    qualifying_1.number, 
    qualifying_1.driverid, 
    qualifying_1.qualifyid, 
    qualifying_1.date, 
    qualifying_1.constructorid
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
  where qualifying_1.number is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of all qualifying sessions and those qualifying sessions where a car number was assigned.

sql:
select  
  races_1.round, 
  races_1.year, 
  races_1.raceid, 
  races_1.time, 
  races_1.name, 
  races_1.date, 
  max(
    races_1.date), 
  races_1.circuitid
from 
  races as races_1
where races_1.time is not NULL
group by races_1.circuitid, races_1.date, races_1.name, races_1.raceid, races_1.round, races_1.time, races_1.year;
nl: Find the latest date for each group of Grand Prix events that have a specified time, showing the round, year, race id, time, name, and date of these events, grouped by circuit, date, name, race id, round, time, and year.

sql:
(select  
    qualifying_1.position, 
    circuits_1.lng, 
    results_1.statusid, 
    qualifying_1.constructorid, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    results_1.number, 
    results_1.resultid, 
    results_1.position, 
    qualifying_1.driverid
  from 
    results as results_1
      inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
        inner join circuits as circuits_1
        on (qualifying_1.qualifyid = circuits_1.circuitid )
      on (results_1.resultid = circuits_1.circuitid )
  where circuits_1.circuitid is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    qualifying_1.position, 
    circuits_1.lng, 
    results_1.statusid, 
    qualifying_1.constructorid, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    results_1.number, 
    results_1.resultid, 
    results_1.position, 
    qualifying_1.driverid
  from 
    results as results_1
      inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
        inner join circuits as circuits_1
        on (qualifying_1.qualifyid = circuits_1.circuitid )
      on (results_1.resultid = circuits_1.circuitid )
  where results_1.rank is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of qualifying sessions for races held at tracks with known identifiers and those where drivers have a specified rank, including the qualifying position, track longitude, status after the race, constructor identifier, track reference, car number, result identifier, final position in the race, and driver identifier.

sql:
select  
  circuits_1.circuitref, 
  circuits_1.country, 
  avg(
    circuits_1.circuitid), 
  circuits_1.location, 
  circuits_1.lng, 
  circuits_1.circuitid, 
  sum(
    circuits_1.circuitid)
from 
  circuits as circuits_1
where circuits_1.lng = circuits_1.alt
group by circuits_1.circuitid, circuits_1.circuitref, circuits_1.country, circuits_1.lng, circuits_1.location;
nl: What are the circuit reference, country, average and total circuit IDs, location, and longitude for each race track where the longitude equals the altitude, grouped by unique track identifiers?

sql:
(select  
    standings_1.driverid, 
    standings_1.points, 
    standings_1.wins, 
    standings_1.position
  from 
    standings as standings_1
  where standings_1.driverid is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    standings_1.driverid, 
    standings_1.points, 
    standings_1.wins, 
    standings_1.position
  from 
    standings as standings_1
  where standings_1.raceid > standings_1.position
  );
nl: Find all driver standings, excluding those where the race ID is higher than the driver's position.

sql:
(select  
    results_1.rank, 
    drivers_1.forename
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
          inner join results as results_1
          on (results_1.driverid = drivers_1.driverid )
        on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
      inner join standings as standings_1
      on (constructors_1.constructorid = standings_1.driverstandingsid )
  where standings_1.driverid is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    results_1.rank, 
    drivers_1.forename
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
          inner join results as results_1
          on (results_1.driverid = drivers_1.driverid )
        on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
      inner join standings as standings_1
      on (constructors_1.constructorid = standings_1.driverstandingsid )
  where constructors_1.name is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all instances of a driver's rank and forename, excluding those that are associated with a constructor having a name.

sql:
(select  
    constructor_standings_1.position, 
    constructor_standings_1.raceid, 
    constructor_standings_1.wins, 
    constructor_standings_1.points, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, 
    constructor_standings_1.date
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
  where constructor_standings_1.points < constructor_standings_1.points
  )
UNION
(select  
    constructor_standings_1.position, 
    constructor_standings_1.raceid, 
    constructor_standings_1.wins, 
    constructor_standings_1.points, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, 
    constructor_standings_1.date
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
  where constructor_standings_1.position is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of team standings with no points and those with a known position in the championship rankings.

sql:
select  
  standings_1.raceid, 
  constructor_results_1.points
from 
  constructor_results as constructor_results_1
    inner join standings as standings_1
    on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = standings_1.driverstandingsid )
where standings_1.position is not NULL;
nl: Find the race identifiers and points for constructors where there are corresponding driver standings with a position.

sql:
select  
  constructors_1.constructorref, 
  constructors_1.constructorid, 
  constructors_1.nationality
from 
  constructors as constructors_1
where constructors_1.constructorid <= constructors_1.constructorid;
nl: Find all instances of constructor reference, identifier, and nationality for each racing team.

sql:
(select  
    races_1.time, 
    races_1.round, 
    races_1.name, 
    races_1.circuitid
  from 
    races as races_1
  where races_1.name <= races_1.time
  )
UNION
(select  
    races_1.time, 
    races_1.round, 
    races_1.name, 
    races_1.circuitid
  from 
    races as races_1
  where races_1.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all Grand Prix events where the name comes before the time and all Grand Prix events that have a valid race identifier.

sql:
(select  
    qualifying_2.date
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
            inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
            on (qualifying_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
          inner join qualifying as qualifying_2
          on (qualifying_2.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
        inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
      inner join drivers as drivers_1
        inner join races as races_1
        on (drivers_1.driverid = races_1.raceid )
      on (constructors_1.constructorid = drivers_1.driverid )
  where constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid >= constructor_standings_1.constructorid
  )
UNION
(select  
    qualifying_2.date
  from 
    constructors as constructors_1
            inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
            on (qualifying_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
          inner join qualifying as qualifying_2
          on (qualifying_2.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
        inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
      inner join drivers as drivers_1
        inner join races as races_1
        on (drivers_1.driverid = races_1.raceid )
      on (constructors_1.constructorid = drivers_1.driverid )
  where qualifying_1.number is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding dates of qualifying sessions for constructors that have a higher constructor standings ID than their constructor ID, and finding dates of qualifying sessions for constructors where the car number in the qualifying session is known.

sql:
select  
  qualifying_1.position, 
  constructors_1.constructorid, 
  constructors_1.nationality, 
  constructors_1.constructorref, 
  qualifying_1.date, 
  qualifying_1.raceid, 
  qualifying_1.constructorid, 
  count(
    constructors_1.constructorref), 
  max(
    qualifying_1.constructorid)
from 
  constructors as constructors_1
    inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
    on (qualifying_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
where qualifying_1.raceid is not NULL
group by constructors_1.constructorid, constructors_1.constructorref, constructors_1.nationality, qualifying_1.constructorid, qualifying_1.date, qualifying_1.position, qualifying_1.raceid;
nl: Find the position of each car in qualifying sessions for races, along with details about the team, including how many times each team participated and the highest team identifier, considering only the qualifying results where the race is specified, grouped by team and qualifying session details.

sql:
(select  
    constructor_standings_1.constructorid, 
    constructor_standings_1.date, 
    constructor_standings_1.raceid
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
  where constructor_standings_1.position is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    constructor_standings_1.constructorid, 
    constructor_standings_1.date, 
    constructor_standings_1.raceid
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
  where constructor_standings_1.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all instances of team championship rankings where the position is known, excluding those where the race identifier is also known.

sql:
(select  
    results_1.positionorder, 
    results_1.raceid, 
    results_1.rank, 
    results_1.date
  from 
    results as results_1
  where results_1.resultid is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    results_1.positionorder, 
    results_1.raceid, 
    results_1.rank, 
    results_1.date
  from 
    results as results_1
  where results_1.driverid <= results_1.positionorder
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of race positions and details where a result exists, and finding all instances of race positions and details where the driver's ID is less than or equal to their position order.

sql:
(select  
    races_1.year, 
    races_1.name, 
    races_1.date, 
    races_1.time, 
    qualifying_1.raceid, 
    qualifying_1.number, 
    races_1.raceid
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
      inner join races as races_1
      on (qualifying_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
  where qualifying_1.constructorid is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    races_1.year, 
    races_1.name, 
    races_1.date, 
    races_1.time, 
    qualifying_1.raceid, 
    qualifying_1.number, 
    races_1.raceid
  from 
    qualifying as qualifying_1
      inner join races as races_1
      on (qualifying_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
  where qualifying_1.driverid is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all instances of Grand Prix events with their respective dates, times, and qualifying details for the race, excluding those events where a driver participated in the qualifying session.

sql:
select  
  drivers_1.code, 
  sum(
    drivers_1.driverid), 
  drivers_1.dob, 
  drivers_1.driverref, 
  drivers_1.surname, 
  min(
    drivers_1.driverid)
from 
  drivers as drivers_1
where drivers_1.nationality is not NULL
group by drivers_1.code, drivers_1.dob, drivers_1.driverref, drivers_1.surname;
nl: What are the total and minimum driver IDs for each group of drivers who share the same code, date of birth, reference, and surname, considering only those with a known nationality?

sql:
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorref, 
    qualifying_1.constructorid
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
      inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
        inner join constructors as constructors_1
          inner join circuits as circuits_2
          on (constructors_1.constructorid = circuits_2.circuitid )
        on (qualifying_1.qualifyid = circuits_2.circuitid )
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = circuits_2.circuitid )
  where circuits_1.alt is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorref, 
    qualifying_1.constructorid
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
      inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
        inner join constructors as constructors_1
          inner join circuits as circuits_2
          on (constructors_1.constructorid = circuits_2.circuitid )
        on (qualifying_1.qualifyid = circuits_2.circuitid )
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = circuits_2.circuitid )
  where qualifying_1.position is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding constructors and their corresponding constructor IDs for qualifying sessions held at circuits with known altitude, and finding constructors and their corresponding constructor IDs for qualifying sessions where the position in qualifying is known.

sql:
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorref
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
        inner join races as races_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
      inner join constructors as constructors_1
      on (constructor_standings_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
  where races_1.name < races_1.time
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    constructors_1.constructorref
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
        inner join races as races_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
      inner join constructors as constructors_1
      on (constructor_standings_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
  where constructor_standings_1.date is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all constructors that participated in races where the name comes before the time, excluding those constructors whose participation dates are recorded.

sql:
(select  
    circuits_1.circuitid, 
    constructor_standings_1.points, 
    constructor_standings_2.constructorid, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    constructor_standings_2.wins, 
    constructor_standings_1.wins, 
    constructor_standings_1.date, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
        inner join circuits as circuits_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = circuits_1.circuitid )
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_2
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = constructor_standings_2.constructorstandingsid )
  where constructor_standings_1.wins is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    circuits_1.circuitid, 
    constructor_standings_1.points, 
    constructor_standings_2.constructorid, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    constructor_standings_2.wins, 
    constructor_standings_1.wins, 
    constructor_standings_1.date, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid
  from 
    constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
        inner join circuits as circuits_1
        on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = circuits_1.circuitid )
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_2
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = constructor_standings_2.constructorstandingsid )
  where constructor_standings_2.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of constructor standings at circuits where there were wins and constructor standings at circuits with a known race identifier, including details such as circuit identifiers, points earned by constructors, constructor identifiers, circuit references, number of wins for both sets of constructor standings, dates, and unique standing identifiers.

sql:
(select  
    drivers_1.driverid, 
    drivers_1.dob, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    drivers_1.nationality
  from 
    drivers as drivers_1
  where drivers_1.nationality is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    drivers_1.driverid, 
    drivers_1.dob, 
    drivers_1.surname, 
    drivers_1.nationality
  from 
    drivers as drivers_1
  where drivers_1.dob is not NULL
  );
nl: Find all drivers whose nationality is known, excluding those whose date of birth is also known.

sql:
(select  
    results_1.milliseconds, 
    results_1.position, 
    constructors_1.constructorid
  from 
    results as results_1
          inner join constructors as constructors_1
          on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
        inner join constructors as constructors_2
        on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_2.constructorid )
      inner join results as results_2
      on (results_1.resultid = results_2.resultid )
  where results_1.raceid is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    results_1.milliseconds, 
    results_1.position, 
    constructors_1.constructorid
  from 
    results as results_1
          inner join constructors as constructors_1
          on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
        inner join constructors as constructors_2
        on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_2.constructorid )
      inner join results as results_2
      on (results_1.resultid = results_2.resultid )
  where results_1.statusid <= results_2.driverid
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding race performances, including milliseconds taken and final position, by drivers for their respective constructors in races with known identifiers, and finding similar performances but only when a driver's status is less than or equal to another driver's identifier.

sql:
(select  
    results_1.driverid, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorid, 
    results_1.position
  from 
    results as results_1
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
      on (results_1.resultid = constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid )
  where constructor_standings_1.date > results_1.date
  )
UNION
(select  
    results_1.driverid, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorid, 
    results_1.position
  from 
    results as results_1
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
      on (results_1.resultid = constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid )
  where constructor_standings_1.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding the driver, team, and final position for races where the team's standings date is after the race result date with finding the driver, team, and final position for races where the team has a valid race identifier.

sql:
(select

(select

sql:
(select

    constructor_results_1.date), 
  races_1.raceid, 
  min(
    circuits_1.lat),

  races_2.raceid, 
  races_3.circuitid
from 
  races as races_1
      inner join races as races_2

    inner join circuits as circuits_1
        inner join races as races_3
        on (races_3.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )

      on (circuits_1.circuitid = constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid )
    on (races_2.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
where constructor_results_1.raceid < races_1.round
group by circuits_1.location, races_1.raceid, races_2.raceid, races_3.circuitid;

    standings_1.driverstandingsid,

(select

  from

sql:
(select  
    circuits_1.name, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    races_1.time, 
    circuits_1.lat, 
    constructor_results_1.date, 
    races_1.circuitid, 
    races_1.name, 
    constructor_results_2.date, 
    constructor_results_2.raceid, 
    races_1.year, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid, 
    circuits_1.location, 
    constructor_results_1.constructorid
  from 
    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
        inner join circuits as circuits_1
          inner join races as races_1
          on (races_1.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
        on (constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid = circuits_1.circuitid )
      on (constructor_results_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
  where races_1.time is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    circuits_1.name, 
    circuits_1.circuitref, 
    races_1.time, 
    circuits_1.lat, 
    constructor_results_1.date, 
    races_1.circuitid, 
    races_1.name, 
    constructor_results_2.date, 
    constructor_results_2.raceid, 
    races_1.year, 
    constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid, 
    circuits_1.location, 
    constructor_results_1.constructorid
  from 
    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
        inner join circuits as circuits_1
          inner join races as races_1
          on (races_1.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
        on (constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid = circuits_1.circuitid )
      on (constructor_results_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
  where constructor_results_1.date < constructor_results_2.date
  );
nl: Find all instances of race tracks, their details, and associated Grand Prix events, excluding those where the event date in the team results is earlier than another event date for the same track.

sql:
(select

    constructor_results_1.raceid, 
    constructor_standings_1.points, 
    constructor_results_1.date

    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
      on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid )
  where constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select  
    constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid, 
    constructor_results_1.raceid, 
    constructor_standings_1.points, 
    constructor_results_1.date
  from 
    constructor_results as constructor_results_1

  where constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid is not NULL
  );
nl: Find constructor results for races, excluding those that are also cumulative team standings.

sql:

    results_1.resultid, 
    results_1.date, 
    results_1.raceid, 
    results_1.laps, 
    results_1.points,

  from

(select

sql:
(select

nl: Combine the results of car numbers and their corresponding positions in qualifying sessions with the same information from qualifying sessions.

sql:
(select  
    races_2.date, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, 
    races_2.year, 
    races_2.raceid, 
    races_1.raceid, 
    races_1.round
  from 
    races as races_1
          inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
          on (constructor_standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
        inner join races as races_2
        on (races_1.raceid = races_2.raceid )
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_2
        inner join constructors as constructors_1
          inner join results as results_1
          on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
        on (constructor_standings_2.constructorstandingsid = results_1.resultid )
      on (results_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
  where constructor_standings_1.date = constructor_standings_2.date
  )
UNION
(select  
    races_2.date, 
    constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, 
    races_2.year, 
    races_2.raceid, 
    races_1.raceid, 
    races_1.round
  from 
    races as races_1
          inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
          on (constructor_standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
        inner join races as races_2
        on (races_1.raceid = races_2.raceid )
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_2
        inner join constructors as constructors_1
          inner join results as results_1
          on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
        on (constructor_standings_2.constructorstandingsid = results_1.resultid )
      on (results_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
  where constructor_standings_1.raceid is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of race dates, constructor standings IDs, years, and race IDs for Grand Prix events where teams have achieved standings on the same date, with finding all instances of race dates, constructor standings IDs, years, and race IDs for Grand Prix events where teams have participated in races with known race IDs.

sql:
select  
  constructor_standings_2.raceid, 
  constructor_standings_1.date, 
  count(
    results_1.fastestlap), 
  constructor_standings_1.points, 
  constructor_standings_2.points, 
  results_1.statusid, 
  results_1.position, 
  constructor_standings_2.wins, 
  constructor_standings_1.constructorid, 
  constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, 
  constructor_standings_1.raceid, 
  results_1.points, 
  results_1.resultid, 
  count(*), 
  constructor_standings_2.date, 
  constructor_standings_1.position, 
  avg(
    constructor_standings_2.position)
from 
  constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
    inner join results as results_1
      inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_2
      on (results_1.resultid = constructor_standings_2.constructorstandingsid )
    on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = results_1.resultid )
where constructor_standings_2.points is not NULL
group by constructor_standings_1.constructorid, constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, constructor_standings_1.date, constructor_standings_1.points, constructor_standings_1.position, constructor_standings_1.raceid, constructor_standings_2.date, constructor_standings_2.points, constructor_standings_2.raceid, constructor_standings_2.wins, results_1.points, results_1.position, results_1.resultid, results_1.statusid;
nl: Find the average position of constructors in races where they have points, along with how many times they achieved the fastest lap, their total points, and other performance metrics for each constructor's standing, considering the results of drivers in those races.

  where results_1.driverid is not NULL

(select

nl: Combine the results of all race performances where a driver participated and all instances where the starting position was greater than or equal to the race identifier.

sql:
select  
  constructors_1.constructorid, 
  drivers_1.nationality, 
  constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid, 
  avg(
    circuits_1.lng), 
  results_1.driverid, 
  results_1.points, 
  drivers_1.driverref, 
  constructor_results_1.constructorid, 
  circuits_1.circuitid, 
  constructor_results_1.raceid
from 
  constructor_results as constructor_results_1
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )
      inner join results as results_1
      on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = results_1.resultid )
    inner join circuits as circuits_1
      inner join constructors as constructors_1
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = constructors_1.constructorid )
    on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = circuits_1.circuitid )
where circuits_1.country is not NULL
group by circuits_1.circuitid, constructor_results_1.constructorid, constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid, constructor_results_1.raceid, constructors_1.constructorid, drivers_1.driverref, drivers_1.nationality, results_1.driverid, results_1.points;
nl: Find the average longitude of race tracks where races were held, along with details about the racing teams, their performance in specific races, and the nationality of the drivers, considering all instances of constructor results achieved by drivers at these tracks.

sql:
select  
  qualifying_1.number, 
  max(
    constructor_standings_1.points), 
  drivers_1.code, 
  min(
    standings_1.points)
from 
  standings as standings_1
      inner join races as races_1
        inner join qualifying as qualifying_1
          inner join drivers as drivers_1
          on (qualifying_1.driverid = drivers_1.driverid )
        on (qualifying_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
      on (standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
    inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
    on (drivers_1.driverid = constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid )
where qualifying_1.constructorid is not NULL
group by drivers_1.code, qualifying_1.number;
nl: Find the car number, maximum team points, driver code, and minimum championship points for each group of drivers with the same code and car number, considering performances where a constructor participated in qualifying sessions.

sql:
select  
  results_1.positionorder, 
  results_1.constructorid, 
  results_1.driverid, 
  circuits_1.circuitref, 
  avg(
    results_1.rank), 
  constructors_1.constructorid, 
  constructors_1.nationality, 
  constructors_1.constructorref, 
  min(
    results_1.constructorid), 
  min(
    results_1.date), 
  max(
    results_1.position), 
  min(
    results_1.date), 
  results_1.raceid, 
  avg(
    circuits_1.circuitid), 
  circuits_1.circuitid, 
  results_1.grid, 
  circuits_1.name, 
  drivers_1.nationality
from 
  constructors as constructors_1
      inner join drivers as drivers_1
      on (constructors_1.constructorid = drivers_1.driverid )
    inner join results as results_1
      inner join circuits as circuits_1
      on (results_1.resultid = circuits_1.circuitid )
    on (results_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
where circuits_1.name is not NULL
group by circuits_1.circuitid, circuits_1.circuitref, circuits_1.name, constructors_1.constructorid, constructors_1.constructorref, constructors_1.nationality, drivers_1.nationality, results_1.constructorid, results_1.driverid, results_1.grid, results_1.positionorder, results_1.raceid;
nl: Find the average rank, minimum constructor ID, earliest and latest race dates, maximum final position, and other performance metrics for each combination of circuit, constructor, driver, and grid position, considering races held at circuits with known names, and give details about the nationality of both constructors and drivers.

    standings_2.date)

      inner join results as results_1

        on (results_1.resultid = standings_2.driverstandingsid )
      on (standings_1.driverstandingsid = results_1.resultid )

sql:

    constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid, 
    constructor_standings_1.position,

        on (circuits_1.circuitid = constructors_1.constructorid )

(select

sql:
(select

sql:

    drivers_1.nationality, 
    drivers_1.code,

    constructor_results_1.points,

(select

sql:

      on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )

  )

(select  
    results_1.date, 
    results_1.statusid, 
    drivers_1.dob, 
    drivers_1.code
  from 
    constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      inner join results as results_1
        inner join standings as standings_1
          inner join drivers as drivers_1
            inner join results as results_2

          on (standings_1.driverstandingsid = results_2.resultid )
        on (results_1.resultid = standings_1.driverstandingsid )

  );

sql:

  constructor_standings_1.points,

  constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid, 
  constructor_standings_1.wins, 
  min(
    constructor_standings_1.points), 
  constructor_standings_1.date
from 
  constructors as constructors_1
    inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
    on (constructor_standings_1.constructorid = constructors_1.constructorid )
where constructor_standings_1.raceid is not NULL

sql:
select  
  standings_1.position, 
  circuits_2.lat, 
  results_1.statusid, 
  avg(
    circuits_1.alt)
from 
  circuits as circuits_1
      inner join standings as standings_1
        inner join circuits as circuits_2
          inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
          on (circuits_2.circuitid = constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid )
        on (standings_1.driverstandingsid = constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid )
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = circuits_2.circuitid )
    inner join results as results_1
    on (constructor_standings_1.constructorstandingsid = results_1.resultid )
where circuits_1.country > circuits_2.circuitref
group by circuits_2.lat, results_1.statusid, standings_1.position;
nl: Find the average altitude of race tracks in countries with names that come after the reference name of other race tracks alphabetically, grouped by the latitude of those other tracks, the final status of drivers in races held at the first set of tracks, and the position of drivers in the standings after those races.

sql:
select  
  constructor_results_1.raceid, 
  constructor_results_1.constructorid, 
  circuits_2.lng, 
  constructor_results_1.points, 
  races_1.circuitid
from 
  constructor_results as constructor_results_1
      inner join results as results_1
      on (constructor_results_1.constructorresultsid = results_1.resultid )
    inner join constructor_results as constructor_results_2
          inner join circuits as circuits_1
          on (constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid = circuits_1.circuitid )
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (constructor_results_2.constructorresultsid = drivers_1.driverid )
      inner join circuits as circuits_2
        inner join races as races_1
          inner join drivers as drivers_2
          on (races_1.raceid = drivers_2.driverid )
        on (circuits_2.circuitid = drivers_2.driverid )
      on (circuits_1.circuitid = circuits_2.circuitid )
    on (results_1.driverid = drivers_2.driverid )
where drivers_1.code > circuits_1.location;

sql:

sql:
select  
  standings_1.raceid, 
  constructor_standings_1.constructorid, 
  drivers_1.surname, 
  constructor_standings_1.points, 
  standings_1.driverstandingsid, 
  drivers_1.forename, 
  count(
    standings_1.date)
from 
  standings as standings_1
      inner join races as races_1
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (races_1.raceid = drivers_1.driverid )
      on (standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
    inner join constructor_standings as constructor_standings_1
    on (constructor_standings_1.raceid = races_1.raceid )
where drivers_1.dob = constructor_standings_1.date
group by constructor_standings_1.constructorid, constructor_standings_1.points, drivers_1.forename, drivers_1.surname, standings_1.driverstandingsid, standings_1.raceid;
nl: Find how many times each driver, along with their corresponding team and points, participated in races where the driver's birthdate matches the race date, considering the cumulative rankings of drivers and teams.

sql:
select  
  circuits_1.circuitref, 
  drivers_1.surname, 
  min(
    drivers_1.dob), 
  circuits_1.lng, 
  circuits_1.lat, 
  max(
    circuits_1.lat), 
  drivers_1.driverref, 
  max(
    circuits_1.alt), 
  drivers_1.driverid, 
  avg(
    circuits_1.alt), 
  avg(
    circuits_1.lat)
from 
  drivers as drivers_1
    inner join circuits as circuits_1
    on (drivers_1.driverid = circuits_1.circuitid )
where drivers_1.driverref <= circuits_1.location
group by circuits_1.circuitref, circuits_1.lat, circuits_1.lng, drivers_1.driverid, drivers_1.driverref, drivers_1.surname;
nl: Find the circuit reference, driver surname, youngest driver birthdate, circuit longitude, circuit latitude, highest circuit latitude, driver reference, highest circuit altitude, driver ID, average circuit altitude, and average circuit latitude for each group of circuits where the driver reference is less than or equal to the circuit location, considering performances of drivers at their respective circuits.

sql:

    circuits_2.country, 
    drivers_1.code, 
    races_1.time, 
    drivers_1.dob, 
    circuits_2.lat, 
    circuits_2.alt, 
    races_2.raceid
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
          inner join races as races_1
          on (races_1.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (races_1.raceid = drivers_1.driverid )
      inner join races as races_2
        inner join circuits as circuits_2
        on (races_2.circuitid = circuits_2.circuitid )
      on (races_2.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
  where races_1.date is not NULL
  )
EXCEPT
(select distinct 
    circuits_2.country, 
    drivers_1.code, 
    races_1.time, 
    drivers_1.dob, 
    circuits_2.lat, 
    circuits_2.alt, 
    races_2.raceid
  from 
    circuits as circuits_1
          inner join races as races_1
          on (races_1.circuitid = circuits_1.circuitid )
        inner join drivers as drivers_1
        on (races_1.raceid = drivers_1.driverid )
